name: butler-mcp
description: Cross-tool shared memory and multi-agent coordination for AI coding agents via local SQLite.
long_description: Local-first MCP server giving AI coding agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Kiro CLI, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed) persistent, cross-tool shared memory and multi-agent coordination via a local SQLite event log. Resume in one tool exactly where another left off.

butler_db_path.title: Database Path
butler_db_path.description: Absolute path to the Butler SQLite database file (leave blank to use ~/.butler/butler.db)
